Scope: .github/workflows/closing-target-claim-guard.yml, .github/workflows/duplicate-fix-guard.yml, .github/workflows/partof-closing-keyword-guard.yml, .github/workflows/pr-body-guards.yml, .github/workflows/single-claim-path-guard.yml + scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs, scripts/check-closing-target-claim.mjs, scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs, scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs

Director seat (summon #52, ledger objectstack#12708), after the fact by the maintainer's word 「#26566、#26568、#26570、#26585 也要追加复审，虽然我已经点了合并」: approved by `os-zhuang` at `9d3c1566` (2026-10-27T09:49Z), merged 2026-10-27T10:05Z; this record reads that head, read-only — the diff, card #26071 and its ruling (comment 6416984681, letter A (iii)), the head's check runs. `dispatch-gates --tier`: `.github/workflows/**` ⇒ the rules face, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Transport is faithful.** Four workflows retired, one added. Comparing the retired files' non-comment lines against `pr-body-guards.yml`: every gate step, its `uses:` pins (`github-script@v9`, `checkout@v7`, `setup-node@v7`), `env:` keys and script bodies are present unchanged; what differs is exactly what a merge must change — workflow `name:`, the concurrency group, job key, the four step `name:` values now carrying the retired jobs' display names, `timeout-minutes` 5 → 10 (the largest retired value). Nothing a guard reads or refuses moved.
- **Legs preserved per guard, premise deviation handled honestly.** The ruling's text says "the `merge_group` trigger the three guards carry today"; on the tree only `closing-target-claim-guard.yml` subscribed `merge_group:` (the other two retired headers say so in words). The new file keeps the letter: `on: pull_request [opened, edited, reopened, synchronize] + merge_group`; closing-target runs on both legs (`if: !cancelled()`), the other three are gated `!cancelled() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'`. No guard gains or loses a leg; the deviation is named in the PR body and the file header rather than silently "fixed" into the ruling's wording.
- **`!cancelled()` on every step** keeps all four verdicts visible on one run — a refusal by the first guard no longer hides the other three, which is the one behavioural improvement over four files, and the ruling's stated reason for the merge.
- **Permissions and concurrency.** `permissions:` is the union of the four retired grants and all read (`contents`, `issues`, `pull-requests`); the group `pr-body-guards-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}` is per PR on the `pull_request` leg and per queue ref on `merge_group`, so no queue build cancels another PR's run.
- **The check-run name changes and every pin follows.** `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` (registry file/job), `check-single-claim-paths.mjs` (`WIRING_WORKFLOW`), the closing-target and partof scripts, and the `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` specimen all point at the new file/job; `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` is untouched (none of the four retired names was a required context, and the new one is not added). The head's run shows the new name `PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path)` green and none of the four retired names — the rename took.

### ② Semver level

`.github/workflows/**` and `scripts/**` publish nothing; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` in the body. No level owed. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed path (workflows): landed under a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval (`os-zhuang`, at this head). The seat records only.
- Check runs pinned to `9d3c1566`: 47 `success`, 12 expected skips, 0 other — including `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` (the parity/single-claim pins), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test Core`, `Test UI` (16 shards), and the new guard job itself. No local re-run.
- The `merge_group` leg of the new file was not exercised by this PR's own runs (a PR run is the `pull_request` leg); its first queue build after landing is where the closing-target step's `MERGE_GROUP_HEAD_REF` path shows. The script body on that path is byte-identical to the retired one, so the exposure is the trigger wiring only.
- Head branch `claude/project-thread-31axox-2` is the card thread's second serial PR, as the seat's claim names; the body flags that PR (iii)'s closing keyword will need a full-name `Claim:` for `-3` — a hand-back to the lane seat, not a must-fix here.

### ④ Design judgment

- `pr-body-guards.yml` against the ruling (letter A (iii), "four PR-body guards → one workflow, keep each guard's leg"): holds. One job, four verdicts on one run, legs unchanged per guard, read-only permissions, per-PR concurrency. The long header comments explain the single divergence (which guard owns `merge_group` and why) at the place a future editor would otherwise "correct" it; that is the right home for the premise note.
- The four retired files: removal is complete (no stray reference in `.github/`, the scripts' pins moved, the self-test specimen moved); the parity gate and the single-claim wiring gate are what will refuse a future PR that forgets the rename again, and both are green on this head.
